granted_by: the EXPLICIT MAINTAINER APPROVAL of 2026-09-16, given after independent review of commit 2f14ad44f48d1df7ce9bb4547343d95da806010a. That commit is recorded here as HUMAN PROVENANCE and is deliberately NOT a machine-verified identity: the formal order is grant committed -> launch_bound sweep on that clean tree -> commit only the readiness record -> issue on the resulting clean HEAD, so the authorization's session commit is necessarily LATER than this document and no grant field may be required to predict it. The approval states its own scope and its own ceiling and forbids substituting C1's $15.1475 per-session figure.
covers: exactly ONE Phase-C2 Search-1 launcher session at a hard ceiling of $15.0446: one beam search over the frozen four-operator Search-1 space under SCHEDULE_V1 (beam width 6, one warmup level), ATTENTION fixed to attention.activation_importance_v1 and branched only across its two declared calibration profiles, DEPTH/FFN/RESIDUAL_WIDTH held at their accepted profiles, operator order free; plus, CONDITIONALLY, exactly one rebuild of the frozen C1 baseline B when the deterministic rule finds the beam did not re-derive it; plus the required c2_baseline_comparison.json B->C search-stage evidence. Nothing in the space, the schedule, the profiles, the B identity contract or the pricing semantics may move.
explicitly_not_authorized: any behavioural confirmation of B vs C
any C1 rerun, reseeding or battery change
a second formal Search-1 execution after the beam search has begun

one_use.what_that_means: this authorization funds ONE launcher session. Inside it the launcher may replace a host that never became usable, up to three provider resources in total, ALL sharing this session's single $15.0446 ceiling. The three are host draws inside one launcher session, NOT three scientific attempts. A create request that returns no provider resource id created nothing and billed nothing and is not a provider resource. It may never have two resources billing at once: the next resource is not created until the provider confirms the previous one is no longer billing.
one_use.machine_readable: the four values above are copied into the authorization as C2ResourceScope and checked by resource_scope_gate before provider creation. They were prose in attempt 1's grant and enforced by nothing.
one_use.consumed_when: the formal launcher is invoked under this authorization, whether or not a provider resource follows and whether or not any money is spent.
one_use.retry_rule: ordinary engineering failures BEFORE the beam search begins may be diagnosed and repaired under AGENTS.md P12.1 inside this one launcher session, provided the reviewed executable and scientific identities are unchanged. Once the beam search has begun, a failure is NOT retried: preserve evidence, tear down, reconcile spend and return to the maintainer. A formal experiment retry needs a new maintainer decision.

bound_identities_the_issuer_must_reprodu._rule: stated here as the maintainer's approval basis and RE-DERIVED by the issuer from the committed objects. The issuer refuses if any of them disagrees. Exactly these seven, and NO COMMIT IDENTITY: each is a property of the TREE rather than a point in its history, which is what makes them satisfiable by a document written before the readiness sweep and the issuance it precedes.

approved_money._ceiling_rule: $15.0446 is the MAXIMUM authorization for this session and every provider resource inside it shares it. The maintainer forbids rounding it upward and forbids substituting C1's $15.1475 per-session ceiling, which belongs to a different package and a different experiment.
approved_money.price_rule: the live NVIDIA L40S securePrice must be re-queried immediately before provider creation. ABOVE $1.09/h the session STOPS at $0: the ceiling is not enlarged, the pricing product is not switched and the market is not chased upward.

approved_runtime_envelopes._beam_rule: the DEPTH-early base plus beam_composition_risk and NOTHING else. It excludes the baseline rebuild reserve, which is not the beam's to spend.
approved_runtime_envelopes._baseline_rule: conditional, on its own clock, started only if the deterministic rule establishes B is absent.
approved_runtime_envelopes._recovery_rule: reachable by neither the search nor the rebuild. Neither scientific path may intentionally consume it.

budget_context_at_approval._source: logs/budget/ledger.md; restated by the maintainer in the approval

interpretation_discipline: the Search-1 state_eval result is HYPOTHESIS-GENERATION evidence only. It is not behavioural recovery evidence and must not be described as a demonstrated student capability improvement. If B remains preferred, the result is a constrained search-stage null under this space and this cheap metric; if a structurally different C is promising, its exact path, spec and artifact identity are frozen and it remains search-stage evidence. C1 remains closed and frozen.
stop_conditions: any $0 pre-provider gate refuses -- stop at $0

continuing would require a source/config/test change, a new authorization, another formal launcher session, an increased budget or a changed scientific protocol -- tear down, reconcile and stop for review
the beam search has begun and anything fails -- preserve, provider-confirmed teardown, reconcile, report; do not launch another Search-1
Search-1 completes with any outcome -- collect the run-owned evidence and manifest, confirm zero billing resources, reconcile spend and STOP
